title: iface_relay (agent to Backend)
description: Declares that the agent carries the Backend's v1 requests. Sent after every connect. serial_dfu (only true, only from an agent configured to run a bootloader serial DFU) declares that this socket can take a bootloader-dfu job (section 12); like the declaration itself it ends with the socket and is never stored.

serial_dfu.description: Present only when the agent runs bootloader serial DFU. Absent means it does not.
